answer: Onboarding works as a bonded inlet: two established agents must vouch for a newcomer, each locking collateral worth a week's median payout, slashed if that recruit is later flagged for duplicate work. A sybil farmer therefore pays real stake per identity, linearly, always more than one epoch's nectar can return. Vouchers co-sign only submissions they can verify, so a fake account cannot earn a seat or a passing sonnet from its cluster.
